summary: Completed comprehensive testing of 3 new features: Google OAuth, One-Click RSVP, and Multi-Sport Support. All 14 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified working - Google OAuth button visible in login modal, Sport Type section accessible in Admin Portal > Settings > Website Design with all 4 sports (Lacrosse, Hockey, Soccer, Volleyball) selectable and showing correct positions/scoring actions. One-Click RSVP auto-submit working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Google OAuth implementation follows Emergent Auth pattern correctly - uses auth.emergentagent.com for redirect
POST /api/users/google-login properly creates new users with 'pending' status and 'google' authProvider
One-Click RSVP auto-submit logic in QuickRSVPForm.js uses useRef to prevent double-submission in StrictMode
Multi-Sport config in sportsConfig.js properly defines positions and scoring actions for all 4 sports
WebsiteDesignManager.js correctly renders Sport Type section with sport selection and configuration preview
sportType persists correctly in websiteStyle configuration via POST /api/league-data/websiteStyle
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three new features fully functional: 1) Google OAuth via Emergent Auth - 'Sign in with Google' button in login modal, 2) One-Click RSVP - auto-submits when URL has ?response=yes&name=... parameters, 3) Multi-Sport Support - accessible via Admin Portal > Settings > Website Design > Sport Type tab with Lacrosse, Hockey, Soccer, Volleyball options.
